## Invitations

The outreach record shows that 1963 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 1476 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 75.2 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded, with the attendance total reported against the number invited.

Van days were kept where roads allowed. This approach supported the outreach arrangements in locations that could be reached under the prevailing road conditions. No further attendance or invitation figures are recorded in this section.

## Contact

Contact arrangements included SMS messaging and reminder messages. A total of 1632 invitations went with an SMS, and 1632 people received a reminder message. The same figure is recorded for both forms of contact.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
